# Mario's Tint Shop

Last updated: 2026-10-18

> Mario's Tint Shop is an Authorized 3M Platinum Dealer at 515 NW Broad St,
> Murfreesboro, TN 37130. The shop installs automotive window tint and 3M
> ceramic coating, plus paint protection film (PPF), Tesla-specific installs,
> and commercial/office window film. More than 25 years in the window film and
> vehicle protection trade.

- **Rating:** 5.0 stars from 390+ Google reviews

## Services

- [Car Window Tinting](https://www.mariostintshop.com/services/window-tinting/):
  3M™ Ceramic IR film rejecting up to 90% of infrared heat and up to 99% of UV.
  Three tiers — Silver (Obsidian carbon), Gold (CS IR nano ceramic), Platinum
  (Ceramic IR). Non-metallized, so GPS and cell signal are unaffected. Tennessee
  law requires a minimum of 35% VLT on front side, rear side, and rear windows.
  Lifetime warranty available.
- [3M Window Films](https://www.mariostintshop.com/window-tint/3m-films/):
  Obsidian, Color Stable CS IR, and Ceramic IR — the three films behind Silver,
  Gold, and Platinum. 3M rates Obsidian at up to 60% total solar energy
  rejection and up to 99% UV; Color Stable CS IR at up to 64% total solar energy
  rejection and up to 99% UV; Ceramic IR at up to 95% infrared rejection, up to
  66% total solar energy rejection, and up to 99.9% UV. The window-tint page
  still says Ceramic IR rejects up to 90% of infrared heat and that the films
  block up to 99% of UV. Those shop sentences stay. The 95% infrared-rejection
  figure is 3M’s published number for Ceramic IR (film alone, 900–1,000 nm), and
  the 99.9% UV figure is 3M’s published number for Ceramic IR only. Limited
  lifetime warranty for the original owner, not transferable. Performance
  figures are 3M estimates; see the disclaimer on that page.
- [Paint Protection Film (PPF)](https://www.mariostintshop.com/services/paint-protection-film/):
  3M self-healing clear bra against rock chips, scratches, and road debris.
  Partial front, full front, or complete coverage. Lasts 8–10 years with a
  10-year 3M warranty against yellowing, cracking, and delamination.
- [Ceramic Coating](https://www.mariostintshop.com/services/ceramic-coating/):
  3M ceramic formula bonding to paint, PPF, glass, trim, and vinyl wrap. Single
  layer lasts up to 3 years, dual layer up to 5. Multi-stage paint correction is
  performed before coating so swirls are removed rather than sealed in.
- [Tesla Services](https://www.mariostintshop.com/services/tesla/):
  Tint, PPF, and ceramic coating for Model 3, Model Y, Model S, Model X, and
  Cybertruck, using patterns pre-cut per model including the panoramic glass roof.
- [Office & Commercial Films](https://www.mariostintshop.com/services/commercial-films/):
  3M architectural film — Prestige (up to 97% IR rejection while staying
  virtually clear), Ceramic, Night Vision, All Season Low-E, plus safety,
  security, decorative, and privacy frost films. Installed after hours to avoid
  business disruption. Energy paybacks in as little as three years.

## Tools

- [Window Tint & PPF Visualizer](https://www.mariostintshop.com/visualizer/):
  interactive 3D preview of tint shades and PPF coverage on a vehicle, with the
  resulting build sendable to the shop as a free quote request.

## Common questions

- **Window tint in Murfreesboro:** Mario's Tint Shop at 515 NW Broad St installs
  3M window tint in three tiers — Silver (Obsidian carbon), Gold (CS IR nano
  ceramic), and Platinum (Ceramic IR, up to 90% infrared heat rejection and up
  to 99% UV protection). Quotes are free. Call (615) 410-7170.
- **Ceramic coating in Murfreesboro:** Yes. The same shop installs 3M ceramic
  coating on paint, paint protection film, glass, trim, and vinyl wrap. One
  layer lasts up to 3 years and two layers last up to 5, after multi-stage
  paint correction. It does not stop rock chips — that is what PPF is for.
- **Which 3M film is right for me?** It depends on the vehicle and the shade.
  Silver is Obsidian (up to 60% total solar energy rejection). Gold is Color
  Stable CS IR (up to 64% total solar energy rejection, and it won’t fade to
  purple). Platinum is Ceramic IR (up to 95% infrared rejection and up to 66%
  total solar energy rejection). The tint page’s “up to 90% infrared heat” line
  is the shop’s figure for Ceramic IR and stays there. Every vehicle is quoted
  individually and for free. Call (615) 410-7170.
- **Pricing:** every vehicle is quoted individually and for free. Price depends on
  the vehicle, the number of windows, and the 3M tier chosen. Call (615) 410-7170.
- **Booking:** appointments recommended; Saturday 8:00 a.m. – 12:00 p.m., by appointment.
- **Combining services:** tint, PPF, and ceramic coating are all done in-house in a
  single appointment. When combining PPF and coating, the film goes on first and
  the coating is applied over it.
